verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs show repository contents can be taken out in open formats: you can clone a repository with Git or download a zip snapshot of its files (github-docs-50, github-docs-68, github-docs-32). Community users note the real lock-in is issues, PRs and Actions, which these mechanisms do not carry over and which needed third-party tools like git-bug (github-comm-5, github-comm-8). Missing for 10: a documented full-account export covering issues, PRs, discussions, wikis, Actions and project data in open formats, and evidence of a complete migration path off the platform.
